interpretation: Whole-genome sequencing of primary, lung and pelvic tumors from one patient; EWSR1-NR4A3 was detected in all three. Proposed TRIM37/PLK4 and IL7R treatment connections were hypotheses, without EMC drug testing or expression validation. DMBT1 copy loss also appeared in the blood sample, limiting tumor-specific interpretation. Greater variant counts in the pelvic sample were confounded by sequencing coverage. These findings support investigating evolution across tumor sites but do not establish a treatment target or immunotherapy biomarker.
